specificCases.allegation: Cheating customers in quality and quantity
specificCases.sourceQuote: In 2002/2003, the station was ransacked by over two dozen activists from the Shiv Sena. The activists alleged that the station was 'cheating customers in quality and quantity.'

ownershipHistory: The 'Sher' in the station's name is a patronymic reference to Aslam Sher Khan, former Indian hockey captain, World Cup winner, former Union Minister and Member of Parliament. The station was explicitly identified in news reports as being owned by Khan in the early 2000s. Such origins imply a high level of political connectivity and historically a higher risk profile. The current operating entity is structured as a Proprietorship, registered under GST in 2017.
